UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach the server. Check that the backend is running.
ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
EMAIL_TAKEN: That email already has an account. Try signing in.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details aren't valid. Check the form.
MFA_CHALLENGE_INVALID: That took too long. Sign in again.
MFA_REQUIRED: Confirm with a code from your authenticator app.
PASSWORD_RESET_INVALID: This reset link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session ran out. Sign in again.
PERMISSION_DENIED: You don't have permission to do that.
BUSINESS_NOT_ACTIVE: This business isn't active, so nothing in it can change.
CSRF_FAILED: Please refresh the page and try again.
MFA_INVALID_CODE: That code didn't work. Codes change every 30 seconds.
TOKEN_INVALID: You were signed out. Sign in again.
REFRESH_INVALID: Your session ended. Sign in again.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
ALREADY_MEMBER: That person is already in this business.
LAST_OWNER: A business needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
ROLE_NOT_ASSIGNABLE: Only an owner can change owners.
PERMISSION_NOT_GRANTABLE: That role can't be given this extra permission.
INVITATION_INVALID: This invitation has expired, was cancelled or was already used. Ask for a new one.
INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH: This invitation is for a different email address. Sign in with that email to accept it.
FISCAL_START_LOCKED: The financial year start can't change after set-up.
BASE_CURRENCY_LOCKED: The main currency can't change once the books have entries.
INVALID_STATUS_CHANGE: The business can't move to that status from here.
NAME_TAKEN: That name is already used here. Pick another.
ACCOUNT_NOT_USABLE: That account is hidden or belongs elsewhere. Pick another.
CATEGORY_NOT_USABLE: That category is hidden. Pick another.
CATEGORY_TYPE_MISMATCH: That category is for the other direction (income vs expense).
FOREIGN_CURRENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED: Only the business's main currency can be used for now.
TRANSFER_ACCOUNTS_INVALID: A transfer needs two different accounts.
FEE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only transfers can have a fee.
TRANSACTION_NOT_EDITABLE: Only drafts can be changed. Reload to see where it is now.
TRANSACTION_NOT_POSTED: Only posted transactions can be reversed.
TRANSACTION_NOT_PENDING: Someone already dealt with this. Reload to see where it is now.
APPROVER_MUST_DIFFER: You recorded this, so someone else must approve it.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID: Please reload the page and try again.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This form was already sent with other details. Reload and start again.
PERIOD_CLOSED: That month's books are closed. Pick a later date.
PERIOD_SOFT_CLOSED: That month's books are being closed. Ask an owner or admin.
FISCAL_PERIOD_NOT_FOUND: That date is outside the business's financial years.
REVERSAL_DATE_INVALID: A reversal can't be dated before the original.
DOCUMENT_REJECTED: The file wasn't accepted. Only PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 25 MB.
DOCUMENT_NOT_UPLOADED: The file didn't finish uploading. Try again.
DOCUMENT_NOT_READY: The file is still being checked. Try again in a moment.
BUSINESS_NOT_PROVISIONED: This business's books aren't set up yet. Try again in a moment.
CONFLICT: Someone else changed this at the same time. Reload and try again.
FX_RATE_MISSING: There's no exchange rate saved to convert one of your businesses. Add one, or show each in its own currency.
DATE_RANGE_TOO_LONG: That period is too long. Pick five years or less.
INVALID_MONTH_RANGE: The first month must come before the last.
BUDGET_LINE_DUPLICATE: That category is already in this budget.
GOAL_NOT_ACTIVE: This goal is no longer active.
REPORTING_CURRENCY_REQUIRED: Your businesses use different currencies. Choose one to show them in.
CODE_TAKEN: That code is already used by another account.
LEDGER_ACCOUNT_NOT_USABLE: One of the accounts is hidden or belongs to another business.
LEDGER_ACCOUNT_PROTECTED: This account can't be hidden: the app posts to it, or a money account uses it.
LEDGER_PARENT_INVALID: An account can only sit under another account of the same kind.
LEDGER_CODE_RANGE_FULL: There are no free codes left for this kind of account.
USE_YEAR_CLOSE: The last month of the year closes with the year-end close.
YEAR_HAS_OPEN_PERIODS: Lock or close every month of the year first.
JOURNAL_UNBALANCED: Debits and credits must be equal.
JOURNAL_NOT_REVERSIBLE: This kind of entry can't be reversed.
JOURNAL_HAS_SOURCE: This entry came from a transaction. Reverse the transaction instead.
RECONCILIATION_ALREADY_OPEN: This account already has a reconciliation in progress. Finish that one first.
RECONCILIATION_CLOSED: This reconciliation is finished and can't change.
RECONCILIATION_DIFFERENCE: There is still a difference. Tick off the missing entries, or book the difference.
JOURNAL_LINE_NOT_MATCHABLE: Some entries can't be ticked off here. Reload and try again.
STATEMENT_FILE_UNREADABLE: That file can't be read as a statement. Check it's the CSV or Excel file from your bank, and that the columns are right.
STATEMENT_FILE_TOO_LARGE: That statement is too big. Download a shorter date range from your bank.
STATEMENT_COLUMN_MISSING: The column “{{column}}” isn't in this file. Pick the columns again.
STATEMENT_LINE_NOT_OPEN: Someone already settled this line. Reload to see it.
STATEMENT_LINE_RECONCILED: This line is part of a finished reconciliation, so it can't be unmatched.
SPLIT_TOTAL_MISMATCH: The parts don't add up to the line's amount.
RULE_CATEGORY_MISMATCH: Money in needs an income category, and money out needs an expense category.
TASK_STATUS_INVALID: A task can't move straight to that status. Move it step by step.
ASSIGNEE_NOT_MEMBER: That person isn't a member of this business.
REMINDER_NO_FUTURE_OCCURRENCE: That reminder would never go off. Pick a time in the future.
REMINDER_MANAGED_BY_SOURCE: This reminder comes from a task or recurring transaction. Change it there.
REMINDER_NOT_EDITABLE: This reminder is finished or cancelled, so it can't be changed.
SALARY_CATEGORY_INVALID: Salaries must use a category linked to the Salaries account. Add one in Accounts → Categories.
SCHEDULE_NO_FUTURE_OCCURRENCE: This schedule would never run. Pick a first date that's today or later.
PUSH_NOT_CONFIGURED: Push notifications aren't set up on this server.
AI_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The assistant has used today’s allowance. It resets tomorrow.
AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: The AI assistant isn’t set up on this server.
AI_NO_BUSINESS_ACCESS: You can’t ask about that business.
AI_PROPOSAL_NOT_PENDING: This suggestion was already handled or has expired.
AI_PROVIDER_BUSY: The assistant is busy. Try again in a minute.
AI_PROVIDER_FAILED: The assistant couldn’t answer just now. Try again.
PLAN_LIMIT: Your plan doesn't have room for this. See Settings → Plan.
PLAN_LIMIT_businesses_one: Your plan has room for {{count}} business. Upgrade in Settings → Plan, or archive one.
PLAN_LIMIT_businesses_other: Your plan has room for {{count}} businesses. Upgrade in Settings → Plan, or archive one.
PLAN_LIMIT_members_one: Your plan has room for {{count}} person. Upgrade in Settings → Plan for a bigger team.
PLAN_LIMIT_members_other: Your plan has room for {{count}} people. Upgrade in Settings → Plan for a bigger team.
PLAN_LIMIT_storage_one: This would go over your plan's {{count}} MB of document storage. Upgrade in Settings → Plan, or delete old files.
PLAN_LIMIT_storage_other: This would go over your plan's {{count}} MB of document storage. Upgrade in Settings → Plan, or delete old files.
PLAN_FEATURE_REQUIRED: This comes with Pro. See Settings → Plan.
PLAN_BUSINESS_LOCKED: This business is read-only on your current plan. Upgrade in Settings → Plan, or archive another business.
BILLING_OWNER_ONLY: Only the person who owns this account can pay for or change its plan.
BILLING_NOT_NEEDED: You already have this plan free with no end date, so there's nothing to pay.
PAYMENT_EXPIRED: This payment page was open too long. Start again from Settings → Plan.
PAYMENT_GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE: Paying online isn't available right now. Please try again later.
COUPON_INVALID_not_found: There's no coupon with that code.
COUPON_INVALID_inactive: That coupon has been switched off.
COUPON_INVALID_used_up: That coupon has been used as many times as it allows.
COUPON_INVALID_wrong_plan: That coupon isn't for this plan.
PLATFORM_ADMIN_ONLY: Only platform admins can open this.
PLATFORM_ADMIN_MFA_REQUIRED: Turn on two-step sign-in to use the admin panel.
WORKSPACE_SUSPENDED: This account is suspended. Please contact support.
AI_PAUSED: The AI assistant is paused for a short while. Please try again later.
SIGNUPS_CLOSED: New sign-ups are closed for now. You can join if someone invites you.
CONTACT_NOT_USABLE: That customer or supplier is archived or belongs to another business.
